name: Research-Hardened RAG Evaluation, Real-LLM Validation & Benchmark Expansion
scientific_interpretation_principle: Pipeline validation != Real LLM answer quality != Human-judged correctness. MockLLMProvider validates grounding mechanics, citation parsing, sufficiency routing, and error boundaries. It does not establish real LLM factual accuracy or colloquial Telugu generative quality.

system_a_hybrid_only.description: Hybrid lexical (BM25) + dense retrieval on raw query text

system_b_hybrid_plus_concept_mapping.description: Hybrid retrieval with Telugu/Romanized normalization and cross-lingual concept mapping

system_c_hybrid_plus_concept_mapping_plu.description: Full proposed pipeline: Concept-aware hybrid retrieval with curriculum graph context and sufficiency gating

knowledge_graph_ablation.graph_contribution_analysis: Empirical comparison between System B and System C measures the isolated effect of knowledge graph context and curriculum graph prerequisite expansion on retrieval recall and MRR.

setting_1_raw_query.description: Raw unnormalized user query text directly submitted to hybrid retriever

setting_3_normalized_plus_canonical_expa.description: Normalized query with cross-lingual concept mapping and canonical concept expansion

citation_integrity_metrics.scientific_interpretation: Citation integrity metrics evaluate citation identifier resolution and sentence-level citation attachment within supplied evidence. They do NOT establish real LLM factual accuracy or human-perceived semantic correctness.

real_llm_evaluation.reason: Real LLM evaluation is opt-in. Specify --provider real to execute.

scale.1: Partially correct / partially supported / minor translation or terminology flaws
scale.2: Good / fully correct / strongly grounded / fluent and appropriate academic phrasing

dimensions.correctness: Factual accuracy of engineering concepts relative to university signal processing curriculum (0-2).
dimensions.groundedness: Extent to which all substantive factual claims are strictly substantiated by the cited retrieved materials (0-2).
dimensions.relevance: Directness and specificity of the response addressing the student's question (0-2).
dimensions.completeness: Coverage of expected core principles, equations, or properties required for a thorough answer (0-2).
dimensions.language_appropriateness: Naturalness, fluency, and proper engineering terminology in the requested language/code-mixed style (0-2).

human_evaluation.note: No human scoring panel has rated model completions in this automated release. Results must strictly reflect NOT YET EVALUATED.

limitations: Automated citation integrity validates source identifier presence and sentence coverage; it does not replace human domain expertise.
Real LLM evaluation requires external API credentials and was executed in offline-mock mode for deterministic CI.
Syntactic sentence splitting is a heuristic proxy for atomic propositional claims.
Multimodal content (plots, diagrams, circuit schematics) is currently evaluated on extracted textual captions only.
